items.headline: OpenAI completes for-profit restructuring under nonprofit control
items.summary: OpenAI finalized its transition to a public benefit corporation while keeping the nonprofit foundation in control. The move reshapes its governance and clears the way for further capital raises amid its Microsoft partnership restructuring.

items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.5 with coding gains
items.summary: Anthropic launched its latest Opus model touting improvements in agentic coding and long-horizon reasoning tasks. The release intensifies competition with OpenAI and Google in the enterprise developer market.

items.headline: Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3 model family
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 3 with stronger multimodal reasoning and expanded context handling. The launch marks Google's biggest model update of the year as it pushes deeper into enterprise and consumer products.

items.headline: Nvidia becomes first company to hit $5 trillion valuation
items.summary: Nvidia's market capitalization crossed $5 trillion driven by sustained AI chip demand. The milestone underscores how central the company remains to the global AI infrastructure buildout.

items.headline: EU AI Act enforcement provisions take broader effect
items.summary: New obligations under the EU AI Act began applying to general-purpose AI providers operating in Europe. Companies face stricter transparency and risk-assessment requirements as regulators ramp up oversight.

items.headline: Microsoft expands Copilot with autonomous agent capabilities
items.summary: Microsoft rolled out new agentic features across its Copilot suite enabling multi-step task automation in enterprise workflows. The update deepens AI integration across Microsoft 365 and Azure.

items.headline: Meta announces new Llama model and AI data center push
items.summary: Meta detailed its next-generation Llama model alongside massive data center investments to support AI training. The announcement reflects Meta's aggressive spending to compete at the frontier.

items.headline: Anthropic raises new funding round at higher valuation
items.summary: Anthropic secured a fresh capital injection valuing the company well above its prior round. The funds support expanded compute and continued development of its Claude models.

items.headline: OpenAI and Amazon strike multibillion-dollar cloud deal
items.summary: OpenAI agreed to a major compute arrangement with Amazon Web Services to diversify its infrastructure beyond Microsoft. The deal signals shifting dynamics in AI cloud partnerships.

items.headline: xAI launches updated Grok model with new features
items.summary: xAI released an updated version of Grok with improved reasoning and real-time capabilities integrated into X. The update continues Elon Musk's push to compete with leading labs.
